payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Complete if the saved support evidence establishes both that the source background was replaced and that the edited background as a whole is recognizable as a basketball-court playing area. Basketball props, a floor strip, or an isolated line without coherent court context are not sufficient for completion. Partial if evidence establishes basketball-related background progress but not a recognizable court. Absent only if evidence establishes no requested background progress. Unknown if the source-to-edit change or court recognizability remains genuinely unresolved; do not resolve conflicting reports by privileging either one, and do not infer visual facts absent from the supports.
node.binding: Target: The background is visibly a basketball court, with recognizable court features such as a playing surface and court markings or basketball equipment.. Reference: The input image and the requested background change in R1..
